title: feat(console): Manage views restores the factory version of a customized package view
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XURgXCZHcjPoyo5g9cMEATi)_
Fixes #36011

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在列表页「管理视图」里，能看到哪些随应用安装的视图被改过（小标记「已定制」），并可一键「恢复出厂版本」；恢复后所有人看到的都是应用自带的视图。
- 属于「视图管理」体验改进：此前改过置顶、默认或名称后，想回到原样只能去 Studio 找定制项。
- 恢复前有一次确认，说明所有使用者都会看到出厂版本；服务器拒绝时会提示原因，定制保持不变。恢复不可撤回，但可再次置顶或重命名生成新的定制。
- 无。

## What changes

On a view a read-only package ships, a pin, a rename or a set-default writes the whole view into the package's customization pair (`PACKAGE.custom`, ruling record 7058654416 keeps those three). Manage views now:

- marks such a row "customized" (served with the ADR-0146 D2 declaration `overrides` naming the package it is served under);
- offers "Restore factory version" in that row's menu; one confirm says every user of the view sees the factory version again; on confirm the override is removed and the views are read again, showing the package's own view;
- offers no restore, and no mark, on a view without a customization; Delete stays hidden and rename, pin, set default and "View config" stay as the ruling has them.

Pieces:

- `@object-ui/data-objectstack`: `ObjectStackAdapter.restoreFactoryView(objectName, viewName)` reads the served view, refuses (sending nothing) when it is no override of its package, takes the pair from the ensure door for that package (the same home `updateView` writes into), and deletes the view's draft then its row there: the existing door `DELETE /meta/view/NAME?package=PAIR`, the one Studio's "Restore package original" uses. A pair that held no row throws. `listViews()` now carries a record's `overrides` onto the flattened row.
- `@object-ui/plugin-view`: `ViewTabItem.customized`, `ManageViewsDialogProps.onRestoreFactory`, the mark and the menu entry.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: the `customized` verdict in the title switcher's Manage views items, and `handleRestoreFactoryView` (confirm, restore, re-read, toast; a refusal is said with the door's message).
- `@object-ui/i18n`: 8 keys in every locale pack (zh-Hant regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`); the de quote-pairing pin counts the two new pairs.

No server, protocol or `packages/spec` change.

## Server door, measured (scratch test, not committed)

Real engine, SQL store, protocol, `HttpDispatcher` reads and `RestServer` delete, both topologies, at 446de0ec / f35f7f31:

- After a pin (`PUT /meta/view/NAME?package=APP.custom` with the declaration): `GET /meta/view?object=OBJ` serves the row with `_packageId` = the base and `overrides: { package: BASE, basedOn }`, in the canonical `config` shape (hence the `listViews` change).
- `DELETE ?package=APP.custom&state=draft` 200 `reset:false`; `DELETE ?package=APP.custom` 200 `reset:true`; the list then serves the base's view with no `overrides`.
- Without `manage_metadata`: 403 `FORBIDDEN` ("Resetting a metadata item requires the `manage_metadata` capability"), the same gate as the pin's write; Manage views is the admin's, as for pin.
- After the last override is removed the pair stays: the ensure door answers it again with `created: false`, so it keeps blocking uninstall (ADR-0146 D3). This PR adds no package deletion.

## Tests

New files: `ManageViewsDialog.restoreFactory-36011.test.tsx` (plugin-view), `restoreFactoryView-36011.test.ts` (data-objectstack), `ObjectView.restoreFactoryView-36011.test.tsx` (app-shell: pin then restore under the real English I18nProvider, the confirm text, a cancelled confirm, a refused restore).

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- At f35f7f31 (pre-merge): 72 test files / 799 tests passed (plugin-view whole package, the three new files, `updateView.draft`, `deleteView.homes`, the 35974 and 11583 ObjectView files); i18n package 105 files / 1962 passed.
- At 767c872b (after merging main): i18n package tests exit 0; the targeted UI run was in progress at hand-over: NOT MEASURED on this head.
- type-check exit 0: plugin-view, data-objectstack, i18n, app-shell (app-shell at 446de0ec, before the i18n commit; not re-run after the merge).
- Ablations (each restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after): restore entry dropped, customized verdict forced false, `overrides` copy dropped from `listViews`, the nothing-removed guard and the not-an-override guard disabled: each turned its pins red.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 767c872b): the local run was in progress at hand-over; every command read so far exited 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Hand-over: work stopped on the maintainer's hand-over call. Unverified on the final head: the targeted UI run after the merge, the app-shell type-check after the merge, and the rest of the derived gate list. CI covers all three.
- The restore removes the pair's draft of the view too, as Studio's restore does.
- Tooling observation, not filed: `os-verify-lock.sh` lost a waiter's slot twice when the budget ran out while that waiter was at the head of the queue; the next call with the same slot name started at the back.
